name: 3d-marquee
title: 3D Image Marquee
blurb: 3D-transformed image gallery with vertical scrolling columns and hover effects.
description: An image gallery with CSS 3D perspective transforms that divides images into 4 columns, each scrolling vertically at different speeds with hover elevation effects.
use_when: Creating visually impressive portfolio or image gallery sections with 3D effects.
avoid_when: On browsers without 3D transform support or when motion accessibility is important.
a11y: Images have alt text, but the 3D effects and animations do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
